source.stem:
Which is the value of a vector quantity?
A 200 V
B 3
100 kg / m
C 20 m / s, east
D 50 J / (kg ° C)

mx.teacher_note: Metre written in words without m is not a standard unit.

intelligence.enrichment: A standard length unit is needed so measurements of the same length made by different people are the same. The International System of Units is adopted as standard units, and the SI unit of length is metre with symbol m. shared standard unit -> comparable measurements across people and places The learner correctly applies this rule: A standard length unit is needed so measurements of the same length made by different people are the same. The International System of Units is adopted as standard units, and the SI unit of length is metre with symbol m. Any familiar unit that people use for length is a standard unit.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Measurement of length and motion. The student must decide: Decide whether a length unit is suitable as a standard unit for shared measurements. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register.
